title: Query bound for bounded influence learning
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, and let $epsilon$ be a rational learning parameter with $0<epsilonle 1/2$. For every hypothesis and cost pair in the support of the query-learning program run with target $f$, the number of membership queries is at most $2^{40}(n+1)^2(B+1)^8/epsilon^{10}$, where $B$ is the family bound determined by $t$ and $epsilon$.
